text:
Predicates:
AllowedPets(x, y) ::: pets allowed in building y.
DepositRequired(x, y) ::: deposit is required to rent in building y.
EqualOrMore(x, y) ::: deposit x is equal to or more than y.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
Rent(x, y) ::: rent for apartment y.
RentAmount(y, z) ::: rent of y is z dollars.
WillRent(x, y) ::: x will rent apartment y.
CanMoveWith(x, y) ::: x can move in with y.
AllowedDeposit(x, y) ::: allowed deposit for renting y.
Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a pet.
Cat(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a cat.
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
ManagedBuilding(OliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
RentAmount(OliveGarden, 2000) ::: The rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
2000 > 1500 ::: 2000 is more than 1500.
TomWillRentIfAllowedAndDeposit(x, y) ::: Tom will rent if allowed to move with Fluffy and deposit is no more than $1500.
Conclusion:
AllowedPets(Fluffy, OliveGarden) ::: Fluffy is allowed in Olive Garden.
DepositRequired(OliveGarden, x) ::: a deposit is required at Olive Garden.
EqualOrMore(x, 1500) ::: deposit x is at least 1500.
2000 ≥ 1500 ::: The rent of Olive Garden is more than or equal to $1500.
AllowedDeposit(OliveGarden, x) ∧ x ≥ 2000 ::: The allowed deposit at Olive Garden is at least $2000.
